g.text: RESERVED, do not use as GPIO:

g.desc: RESERVED, do not use as GPIO:

g.text: Source: ESP32-S3 Series Datasheet, Boot Configurations

g.desc: Source: ESP32-S3 Series Datasheet, Boot Configurations

g.text: 10uF bulk + 1uF storage + 10nF decoupling per ADS7883 (SLAS594 p.11, Fig. 25). VDD is the reference: supply noise is code noise.

g.desc: 10uF bulk + 1uF storage + 10nF decoupling per ADS7883 (SLAS594 p.11, Fig. 25). VDD is the reference: supply noise is code noise.

g.text: TX->RX crossed at the other end. Common GND required.

g.desc: TX->RX crossed at the other end. Common GND required.

g.text: UART1, not UART0. Console runs over USB Serial/JTAG.

g.desc: UART1, not UART0. Console runs over USB Serial/JTAG.

g.text: R10: every GPIO floats until firmware configures it. One pull-up on the shared CS holds both converters deselected at boot.

g.desc: R10: every GPIO floats until firmware configures it. One pull-up on the shared CS holds both converters deselected at boot.

g.text: 10uF bulk + 1uF storage + 10nF decoupling per ADS7883 (SLAS594 p.11, Fig. 25). VDD is the reference: supply noise is code noise.

g.desc: 10uF bulk + 1uF storage + 10nF decoupling per ADS7883 (SLAS594 p.11, Fig. 25). VDD is the reference: supply noise is code noise.

g.text: 220R in series on each link line: limits current into an unpowered board's ESD diode, damps ringing. At 2 Mbaud, RC is about 5 ns against a 500 ns bit.

g.desc: 220R in series on each link line: limits current into an unpowered board's ESD diode, damps ringing. At 2 Mbaud, RC is about 5 ns against a 500 ns bit.

g.text: No external pull-ups on encoders or buttons.

g.desc: No external pull-ups on encoders or buttons.

g.text: IO48: onboard WS2812 status LED, driven over RMT.

g.desc: IO48: onboard WS2812 status LED, driven over RMT.
